title: [finding] post-stamped reports an oversized comment body (a real HTTP 422 from the platform) as exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET with a transport remedy that cannot work — a size refusal has no class of its own, and the class it gets tells a caller to retry elsewhere
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat (`session_01Gqi43smmqjJ5sUrhfoPeKu`, seat post #7623) out of the #18806 round (PR #18841), from the dev's out-of-scope findings, re-read by the seat before filing. ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only, `domain:*` / type / priority are triage's (lane self-triage exception noted). ⛔ Not fixed in PR #18841: that card's surface is the five workflow files, and this is `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`.

Dedupe words: `post-stamped exit 3 oversized body` · `EXIT_PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET 422` · `refusal text prescribes a remedy that cannot work` · `comment cap refusal class` · `PREREQUISITE NOT MET HTTP 422` · `size refusal class`.

## The reading, on `origin/main` `fbe5e1e1f5` and probe objectstack#18826 at 2026-09-17T23:1xZ

- Reproduced twice by the #18806 dev (writes 5 and 6 of the comment bisection on objectstack#18826): a 262,145-byte comment body through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=18826 --file=…` — the platform answers a real HTTP 422 (「Body is too long (maximum is 65536 characters)」 — a text false in unit and value, see #18826's record) — and post-stamped exits **3**, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, 「no route, no act at all」, with the remedy 「run this where node's fetch reaches api.github.com with a token that can write issues」.
- The write WAS routed, answered and refused. The remedy cannot work for this cause, and the class reads as a transport failure a caller would retry — on another route, with another token — and be refused again. The file's own header names this shape: 「a refusal text prescribing a refused remedy is a tool arguing with itself」.
- A size refusal is neither exit 3 (no route) nor exit 4 (a read-back mutation) today. The boundary it should name is now measured on both surfaces (#18793: issue body 262,144 B; #18826: comment 262,144 B, both endpoints), and `check-half-states.mjs` already declares `ISSUE_BODY_LIMIT` in bytes since PR #18796.

## Shape (⛔ a proposal, not a prescription)

A 422 whose message names the body length gets its own exit class and text: the byte count sent, the measured cap for that surface (issue body / comment, from the declared constants or a sibling for the comment cap), and the remedy that works — shorten the body or split it — ⛔ not a route remedy; a pin per surface with the refusal text held apart from the 「no route」 text. Whether the two caps live as one declared constant in `check-half-states.mjs` (a `COMMENT_BODY_LIMIT` beside `ISSUE_BODY_LIMIT`) is the same card.

## ⛔ Not measured

- Whether any live seat comment has hit this refusal outside the probe (the seat's largest comment today is ~8.4 KB; none has).
- The exact 422 message on `updateComment` vs `createComment` (the dev read them as the same string; #18826's record has the verbatim text).
